chapter: Producing, state of New Orleans music
title: The Neville Brothers and the supposed split
summary: He denies a split, saying he never worked with the Neville Brothers as a unit and last worked with Aaron on Hercules.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That was for the boat, and it belonged to the boat. Is there going to be another boat piece for the 26th? Probably. I'll definitely be looking forward to that. Something, I guess this is really unavoidable. The following question. Could you give your rendition of what caused the split between you and the Neville brothers? Because they were on and they gave their side of the story. And a lot of people have asked me to ask you this question.

As to why that happened. I mean, the two of the biggest forces in New Orleans music. Because you had worked with them for so many years. And I think they're really largely responsible for their success.

Well, the Neville brothers, as a unit, I never worked with. Right. That happened after they come from wherever they were with whoever they were and got together. Mm-hmm. So, I imagine to do that, that in itself takes them away from wherever they were, whoever they were with. Mm-hmm. So, that's all I can see there. I never worked with them as a unit. Aaron, I worked with him a long time ago. Mm-hmm. And for a long time as an artist. Of course, art was with the meters, as the meters. Which, they were a self-contained group. They could go in any time and record on their own. And do their own thing. So, that wasn't a whole lot of grouping for the Neville brothers. As to say, they were once me and the Neville brothers, then no more. Right. There was never a me and a Neville brothers.

Well, I didn't mean that. The Neville brothers is the band, but I should have said it's the individuals. And specifically with the album that supposedly Aaron Neville cut here for Island Records. I think it was going to be called Feelings. Was there an album produced here that is unreleased by him?

Yes. I didn't go in with them. By that time, I wasn't working with Aaron anymore. In fact, back during the days of Hercules is the last time I actually worked with Aaron. And there was an album during the feeling time with Wardell. Because they went in with him. And it was really nice. I don't know exactly what became of it. But, yes, there was an album.
So it's just unreleased. Is Island probably on the rights to it? I guess so. Could you conceive of working with them again? Them being her? Well, either as the Neville brothers or as individuals.

Well, as a group, and I would hope that the group would stay together. So I'd have to think of them as a group. Right. Because as individuals, that's either a result of something really good or really bad. Right. Yes, in my day, I write songs and arrange and produce. So that just may happen. I don't see it right up the road anywhere to say, yes, March the 15th or anything. But that's possible.
